Name: House of the Forest of Lebanon
Description: Solomon's great pillared hall in Jerusalem, named for its cedar columns from Lebanon, where he kept his gold shields and drank from gold vessels; its treasures were still shown to the Queen of Sheba's successors in Chronicles.
BiblicalSignificance: The house joined Lebanon's forests to Jerusalem's throne: cedar turned into a hall of state, and its gold became the measure of Solomon's glory.
